novel_policies.label: compact privilege jurisprudence requirement
novel_policies.quote: Meet any jurisprudence requirements established by the remote state in which the licensee is seeking a compact privilege

novel_policies.label: interstate compact member
novel_policies.quote: The purpose of this compact is to facilitate interstate practice of dietetics with the goal of improving public access to dietetics services.

novel_policies.label: does not require continuing education
novel_policies.quote: The panel may recommend additional requirements for license renewal to obtain evidence of a dietitian's continued competency.

novel_policies.label: lacks title protection
novel_policies.quote: "Registered dietitian" means a person who meets the qualifications of the credentialing agency for the American academy of nutrition and dietetics.

novel_policies.label: lacks direct supervision defined
novel_policies.quote: "Supervision" means the management of an individual who aids in the practice of dietetics by a licensed dietitian-nutritionist who may or may not be on the premises.

novel_policies.label: does not authorize enteral parenteral nutrition
novel_policies.quote: Nothing in this subdivision shall be construed to authorize a registered dietitian, or other nutritional professional meeting the qualifications set forth in subdivision (e) of Section 2585, to order or administer a central vein or peripheral vein nutrition.

novel_policies.label: lacks lab test ordering authority
novel_policies.quote: does not include the administration of nutrition by any route other than oral administration, the administration of enteral or parenteral diets or the issuance of orders for laboratory or other diagnostic tests or orders intended to be implemented by any person licensed pursuant to chapter 378

novel_policies.label: does not authorize medical nutrition therapy
novel_policies.quote: "Dietetics/nutrition practice" means the integration and application of principles derived from the sciences of nutrition, biochemistry, food, physiology, management, behavioral, and social sciences to achieve and maintain client health through the provision of nutrition care services

novel_policies.label: lacks nutrition assessment includes biochemical data
novel_policies.quote: Nutrition assessment to include the establishment of nutritional care plans, including the development of nutritional related priorities, goals and objectives.

novel_policies.label: supervision ratio limit
novel_policies.quote: a registered dietitian shall not supervise more than two dietetic technicians, registered at one time.

novel_policies.label: telehealth practice authorized
novel_policies.quote: The practice of dietetics. The synthesis and application of dietetics, primarily for the provision of nutrition care services, including medical nutrition therapy, in person or via telehealth, to prevent, manage, or treat diseases or medical conditions and promote wellness.

novel_policies.label: alternative credential pathways
novel_policies.quote: has qualified as a diplomate of the American Board of Nutrition or as a Certified Nutrition Specialist with the Certification Board for Nutrition Specialists

novel_policies.label: animal nutrition exemption
novel_policies.quote: an animal nutritionist whose activities are limited to the nutritional care of animals; animal nutritionists may use the title 'nutritionist' as long as they provide nutrition services only to animals

novel_policies.label: ethics code violation grounds for discipline
novel_policies.quote: Has violated the Code of Ethics as established by the American Dietetic Association

novel_policies.label: hospital order authority requires policy
novel_policies.quote: A hospital... may allow a registered dietitian or other qualified nutrition professional to order diets, enteral feeding, nutritional supplementation or parenteral nutrition if... The hospital's written policies and procedures allow registered dietitians or other qualified nutrition professionals to issue such orders.

novel_policies.label: lab test ordering authority
novel_policies.quote: A registered dietitian... may order medical laboratory tests related to medical nutrition therapy services when approved by the referring physician or the physician responsible for the care of the patient.

novel_policies.label: nonresident temporary practice max days
novel_policies.quote: The dietetics are performed for no more than one hundred eighty (180) consecutive working days

novel_policies.label: physician referral required
novel_policies.quote: a dietitian/nutritionist or registered dietitian meeting the qualifications set forth in Section 34-34-1, may, upon referral by a health care provider authorized to prescribe dietary treatments

novel_policies.label: lacks ethics code violation grounds for discipline
novel_policies.quote: Being guilty of unprofessional conduct as defined by the board.

novel_policies.label: diagnosis treatment prohibition
novel_policies.quote: a person licensed to practice dietetics/nutrition or to provide nutritional care services shall not diagnose, treat, or prescribe for any human illness, injury, disease, impairment, or infirmity, or otherwise engage in the practice of medicine

novel_policies.label: direct supervision defined
novel_policies.quote: 'direct supervision' means the supervising registered dietitian shall be physically available to the dietetic technician, registered for consultation whenever consultation is required.

novel_policies.label: inactive license status available
novel_policies.quote: Upon request, the director may grant inactive status to a person licensed under this chapter.

novel_policies.label: uses a none credential
novel_policies.quote: "Registered dietitian" means a person who meets the qualifications of the credentialing agency for the American academy of nutrition and dietetics.

novel_policies.label: regulates by market forces
novel_policies.quote: "Registered dietitian" means a person who meets the qualifications of the credentialing agency for the American academy of nutrition and dietetics.

novel_policies.label: nonresident temporary practice allowed
novel_policies.quote: A nonresident dietitian practicing dietetics in this state, if: (A) The dietetics are performed for no more than one hundred eighty (180) consecutive working days

novel_policies.label: provisional license available
novel_policies.quote: A provisional license to practice as a dietitian may be issued by the Arkansas Dietetics Licensing Board upon the filing of an application and submission of evidence of successful completion of the education requirements.

novel_policies.label: provisional license duration months
novel_policies.quote: A provisional license shall expire eighteen (18) months from the date of issuance.

novel_policies.label: provisional license requires supervision
novel_policies.quote: A provisional license shall permit the holder to practice only under the supervision of a dietitian licensed in this state.

novel_policies.label: diet order writing authority
novel_policies.quote: A certified dietitian-nutritionist may write an order for a patient diet, including, but not limited to, a therapeutic diet for a patient in an institution.

novel_policies.label: does not require post degree experience
novel_policies.quote: received a master's degree or doctoral degree, from an institution of higher education accredited to grant such degree by a regional accrediting agency recognized by the United States Department of Education, with a major course of study which focused primarily on human nutrition or dietetics

novel_policies.label: houses oversight in a division
novel_policies.quote: There is hereby created within the division of professional registration, a committee to be known as the "State Committee of Dietitians". The committee shall assist the division in administering and enforcing the provisions of sections 324.200 to 324.225

novel_policies.label: medical nutrition therapy authorized
novel_policies.quote: The practice of dietetics. The synthesis and application of dietetics, primarily for the provision of nutrition care services, including medical nutrition therapy, in person or via telehealth, to prevent, manage, or treat diseases or medical conditions and promote wellness.

novel_policies.label: nutrition assessment includes biochemical data
novel_policies.quote: Nutritional assessment means the evaluation of the nutritional needs of individuals and groups, based upon appropriate biochemical, anthropometric, physical, and dietary data, to determine nutrient needs and recommend appropriate nutritional intervention, including enteral and parenteral nutrition

novel_policies.label: weight control program exemption
novel_policies.quote: A person who offers weight control programs prepared under the supervision of or approved by a registered dietitian or a licensed dietitian... if the person does not hold himself or herself out under the title of dietitian or licensed dietitian

novel_policies.label: dietetic technician recognized
novel_policies.quote: DIETETIC TECHNICIAN. A person who is trained to perform specific dietetic functions of a licensed dietitian/nutritionist as defined by this chapter under the direct supervision of a licensed dietitian/nutritionist.

novel_policies.label: food supplement sales exemption
novel_policies.quote: Nothing in this chapter is intended to prohibit any person who does not hold himself or herself out to be a dietitian or nutritionist from furnishing general nutritional information on food, food materials, or dietary supplements or from engaging in the explanation to customers about foods or food products in connection with marketing and distribution of those products

novel_policies.label: does not require license
novel_policies.quote: It is a misdemeanor for any person not meeting the criteria of subdivision (a) or (b) to use, in connection with his or her name or place of business, the words "dietetic technician, registered," "dietitian," "dietician," "registered dietitian," "registered dietician," "registered dietitian nutritionist," or the letters "RD," "RDN," "DTR," or any other words, letters, abbreviations, or insignia indicating or implying that the person is a dietitian

novel_policies.label: lacks rd credential accepted in lieu of state requirements
novel_policies.quote: Any person representing himself or herself as a registered dietitian shall meet one of the following qualifications

novel_policies.label: enteral parenteral nutrition authorized
novel_policies.quote: Interpreting and recommending interventions to meet nutrient needs relative to individual health status, including but not limited to medically prescribed diets, tube feedings and specialized intravenous solutions.

novel_policies.label: exempt professions list
novel_policies.quote: A licensed physician, pharmacist, or nurse from engaging in the practice of dietetics if incidental to the practice of his or her profession, and if the person does not hold himself or herself out under the title of dietitian or licensed dietitian

novel_policies.label: uses a certification credential
novel_policies.quote: Any person representing himself or herself as a registered dietitian shall meet one of the following qualifications

novel_policies.label: federal employee exemption
novel_policies.quote: A dietitian who is serving in the armed forces or the United States Public Health Service or is employed by the Department of Veterans Affairs from engaging in the practice of dietetics, provided that the practice is related to that service or employment

novel_policies.label: license type structure
novel_policies.quote: LICENSED DIETITIAN/NUTRITIONIST. A person licensed under this chapter. TEMPORARILY LICENSED DIETITIAN/NUTRITIONIST. A person temporarily licensed under this chapter.

novel_policies.label: protected titles
novel_policies.quote: No person shall... use the title 'Licensed Dietitian,' 'Licensed Nutritionist,' 'Nutritionist,' 'Dietitian,' use the letters 'L.D.N.', or any combination of above terms and/or abbreviations unless such a person is licensed under this chapter.

novel_policies.label: rd credential accepted in lieu of state requirements
novel_policies.quote: Persons who provide evidence of current registration as a registered dietitian awarded by the Commission on Dietetic Registration, credentialing agency of the American Dietetic Association shall be considered to have met the qualifications for licensure under this chapter.
